# GENERATED by tools/gen.py - do not edit by hand, edit the generator and re-run it.
# The party ideology name lapses when the ruling party or the government changes
# (election, coup, set_politics) and, checked daily, when the country leader is not
# the one at Apply (a new leader is how the sub-ideology changes). CAPIE already shows
# the game's name then (CONTRACT 20.3); removing the variables keeps the save
# consistent. No cooldown: it is not a player's action.
on_actions = {
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_sn_ver } rn_subideology_name_carrier_clear = yes }
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_sn_ver } rn_subideology_name_carrier_clear = yes }
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_sn_ver } rn_si_daily_check = yes }
		}
	}
}
